instruction: Add all my friends and roommates as friends on venmo, if they are not already.
notes: The exact contacts are unknown up front, so the model uses placeholder persons friend-1, friend-2 (relationship friend) and roommate-1, roommate-2 (relationship roommate); at runtime they map to the contacts returned by phone.search_contacts for each relationship. Persons are declared as domain constants so supervisor-complete-task can list every goal condition (one venmo-friend fact per contact) in its precondition. friend-2 is marked as already a Venmo friend in :init to model the 'if they are not already' clause: venmo-add-friend requires (not (venmo-friend ?p)) plus knowledge of the current friend list (venmo.search_friends), so no duplicate/erroneous add is planned and no friendships are removed. phone.show_contact_relationships is included as a lookup so the agent uses the exact relationship strings stored in the contact book. Contact emails are obtained by phone.search_contacts (modeled by contacts-found per relationship combined with static contact-relationship/contact-email facts). Static username-for/password-for facts constrain the login actions. Goal: every friend/roommate contact is a Venmo friend and the task is completed; only venmo.Friendship records change.

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'relationship', 'email', 'app', 'person', 'password', 'username', 'token'}
